notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable listing from replication_data.dta, no RESULT lines). Final script: wrights and Domesday mills divided by pcmean (mean population 1710-50); sample = 298 districts with non-missing mills. Wheat suitability = 1{wheat_tmean <= 5}; river suitability = riv_rug26count (river length at ruggedness 2-6); instrument = river suitability x wheat suitability. OLS and 2SLS with fixest, SEs clustered by historical county (GAZ_CNTY, 35 clusters in sample). Controls: main geographic (latitude, longitude, dist_rug_mean, dist_elevation_mean), agricultural (suitmean, wheat suitability, dist_grass_mean), climatic (precip_mean_dist, temp_mean_dist), other (pcmean, min_harbor, DIST_London, min_dist_to_roman_rds, min_dist_2nav_rivers, area). First-stage F = cluster-robust Wald F on the excluded instrument (fixest ivwald1). The 'hetero' F printed in the diagnostic line equals the clustered one because fixest's ivwald1 reuses the first-stage vcov stored at estimation; it is diagnostic only and not scored. No claim-comparison-driven changes were made.
